title: Hourly to Annual Pay: Understanding Your Salary and Tesla Model S Salary Sacrifice Options
description: Convert your hourly rate to annual salary using the 38-hour week. Learn about minimum wage, awards, casual loading, super, and how Tesla Model S salary sacrifice affects take-home

faqs.q: How does casual loading work in the calculator?

faqs.q: Can I use this calculator to estimate pay after a Tesla Model S salary sacrifice?

bodyMarkdown:
## From Hourly Rate to Annual Salary: The Basics

Whether you're negotiating a new job offer or checking your current pay, converting an hourly rate to an annual salary is straightforward. The formula is simple: **hourly rate × hours per week × 52 weeks**. This article assumes a standard full-time week of 38 hours, as defined by the Fair Work Ombudsman. For part-time or casual work, adjust the hours accordingly.

For example, the National Minimum Wage from 1 July 2026 is $26.44 per hour. Multiply by 38 hours and 52 weeks: $26.44 × 38 × 52 = $52,254.88 per year. That's the gross annual pay before tax and super. If you're a casual employee, your rate includes 25% loading, making it $33.05 per hour. The same formula gives $33.05 × 38 × 52 = $65,318.80 per year.

### Fortnightly Pay

Many Australians are paid fortnightly. To find your gross fortnightly pay, multiply your weekly pay by 2. For the minimum wage: $1004.90 per week × 2 = $2009.80 per fortnight. This figure helps when budgeting between pay cycles.

### National Minimum Wage vs. Award Rates

The National Minimum Wage is the legal floor. However, most employees are covered by an award or enterprise agreement that sets higher minimum rates. For example, the [minimum wage](/topics/minimum-wage) page lists the current rate, but your specific award may require a higher hourly rate. Always check your award via the Fair Work Ombudsman's [pay guides](/blog). The calculator lets you enter any base rate, so input your award rate if it differs from the minimum.

### Casual Loading and Super

Casual employees receive a 25% loading in lieu of paid leave. Our calculator has a checkbox to add this loading on top of the base rate you enter. Do not type a rate that already includes casual loading. Superannuation is paid on top of your ordinary earnings at 12% (from 1 July 2026). For the minimum wage: $52,254.88 × 12% = $6,270.59 in super per year. Super is not deducted from your pay; it's an extra contribution by your employer. The maximum super contribution base is $270,830 per year, so super stops once your earnings exceed that.

### Tax and Take-Home Pay

Your take-home pay depends on tax and the Medicare levy. For 2026–27, the resident tax rates are:
- $0–$18,200: nil
- $18,201–$45,000: 15%
- $45,001–$135,000: 30%
- $135,001–$190,000: 37%
- Over $190,000: 45%

Plus a 2% Medicare levy (using 2025–26 single reduction thresholds). The [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) page can help estimate net income. Remember, this calculator does not deduct HELP loans, the Medicare levy surcharge, or salary sacrifice arrangements.

### Salary Sacrifice and the Tesla Model S

Salary sacrifice allows you to exchange part of your pre-tax salary for benefits like a car. For instance, a **Tesla Model S salary sacrifice** arrangement reduces your taxable income, potentially lowering your tax bracket. However, our calculator assumes no salary sacrifice. To understand how such an arrangement affects your net pay, you need a dedicated tool that accounts for fringe benefits tax and reduced super contributions. The [super and packaging](/topics/super-and-packaging) page discusses these complexities.

### Using the Timesheet Calculator

The [timesheet](/) is the home page. Enter your base hourly rate (e.g., $30.00). If you're casual, check the 25% loading box. The calculator then shows your weekly, fortnightly, and annual gross pay, plus estimated tax, Medicare, and super. It's a quick way to compare different rates or job offers.

### Important Notes

- Annual pay is hourly rate × hours per week × 52. It assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, and no salary sacrifice.
- Super is estimated at 12% of ordinary earnings, paid on top, and stops at the $270,830 maximum contribution base.
- Tax uses the 2026–27 resident scale with the full tax-free threshold. Medicare uses the 2025–26 single reduction thresholds because the 2026–27 reduction thresholds were not confirmed here.
- HELP, the Medicare levy surcharge, and salary packaging are not deducted.
- This is an estimate, not a determination of your pay or tax.

### Average Weekly Earnings

The Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) reports Average Weekly Earnings (AWE) for May 2026: full-time adult ordinary time earnings are $2083.70 per week. All employees (including part-time) average $1579.20 per week. These are averages, not medians, and may not reflect your specific job or industry. The [average pay](/topics/average-pay) page provides more context.

### Final Thoughts

Understanding your hourly rate in annual terms helps you compare jobs and plan finances. Whether you're on the National Minimum Wage, an award rate, or a higher salary, the formula remains the same. And if you're considering a **Tesla Model S salary sacrifice**, remember that our calculator gives a baseline before such arrangements. For personalised advice, consult a financial advisor or use the [reference tables](/data) for more detailed calculations.
